messages.subject: Reminder: Commercial Litigation update seminar — 18 March
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear colleagues,

A reminder that the quarterly Commercial Litigation update seminar (disclosure pilot, Part 36 developments and recent Commercial Court decisions) takes place on 18 March, 13:00–14:30 in the Bishopsgate training suite. 1.5 CPD hours. Lunch provided. Please RSVP via the L&D portal.

Learning & Development
